mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oms_warehouse_shipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND package_id = #{packageId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_warehouse_shipment(tenant_id, package_id, sales_order_id, outbound_id, shipped_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{s.packageId}, #{s.salesOrderId}, #{s.outboundId}, #{s.shippedAt})

INSERT INTO oms_warehouse_shipment_line(tenant_id, package_id, pick_id, sales_line_id, seller_sku, quantity) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{packageId}, #{line.pickId}, #{line.salesLineId}, #{line.sellerSku}, #{line.quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT l.sales_line_id, l.seller_sku, CAST(SUM(l.quantity) AS INT) AS quantity FROM oms_warehouse_shipment_line l JOIN oms_warehouse_shipment s ON s.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND s.package_id = l.package_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.sales_order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY l.sales_line_id, l.seller_sku
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_sales_order SET status = #{status}, fulfillment_status = #{fulfillment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND order_id = #{orderId}
